title: Kubo-Martin-Schwinger conditions for non-Hermitian systems
summary: We investigate the extension of the Kubo--Martin--Schwinger (KMS) thermal equilibrium condition to bounded non-Hermitian Hamiltonians with real spectra and biorthogonal eigensystems, providing a unified framework through three complementary constructions: a complete KMS theorem under quasi-Hermiticity, a biorthogonal KMS-type identity whose positivity characterises quasi-Hermiticity, and a quantum-detailed-balance condition for the associated open-system dynamics.
